originalAlarm.description: Value stored to 'm_has_modinfo' is never read

reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: The alarm reports 'm_has_modinfo = 1' (line 18, in the else branch) as a dead store when CONFIG_FEATURE_INSMOD_VERSION_CHECKING is true. In the simplified vbdb file, m_has_modinfo is assigned in the if-else block but never subsequently used (the function proceeds to return exit_status). In the real BusyBox insmod_main() code, m_has_modinfo is used in conditional logic throughout the function. The simplified file stripped those uses. This is a simplification artifact. The known vbdb bug (UndeclaredIdentifier: k_crcs used when VERSION_CHECKING is disabled) is a different issue.
